run_test_evaluation: run the distributed test evaluation on a trained 3D face model using argparse CLI arguments
run_model_inference: run inference with DeepAppearanceVAE or WarpFieldVAE models to predict texture and vertex outputs
run_loss_computation: run the loss computation including vertex, texture, screen space, and KL divergence losses
run_image_saving: run the save_img function to export predicted and ground truth texture and screen images
run_camera_config_generation: run automatic camera config generation from dataset directory when config file does not exist
